# Security Requirements Checklist: MCP Tool Delegation

**Purpose**: Test whether the requirements for the approval gate, the classification rule, and credential handling are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before tasks are written. It tests the wording of the spec and the plan, not the behavior of the code.
**Created**: 2026-11-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [research.md](../research.md) | [contracts/server-config.md](../contracts/server-config.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus**: approval gate coverage for delegate tools and subagents; classification rules; credential pass-through and redaction.
**Depth**: standard. **Audience**: the reviewer of this pull request, before `/speckit-tasks`.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the trust placed in each party stated in one place: the operator and the configuration, a tool server and the text it supplies, and the model? [Gap]
- [x] CHK002 - Are gating requirements stated for every route by which a delegate tool can be called: the orchestrator, a subagent, a run resumed after a pause, and a step that proposes several tools at once? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 - Does the spec require that an edit decision can change only the arguments, never which tool or which server is called? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, Research §R9]
- [x] CHK004 - Does the spec state which environment variables a launched server may receive, so that the service's own secrets, such as the database connection and the model provider key, are excluded by requirement and not only by the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, Contract §Shape]
- [x] CHK005 - Does FR-004 list every startup refusal the design relies on for safety, including an unset `pass_env` variable, a tool name outside the allowed characters, and one of Freyja's own tools with no classification? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Research §R4, §R8]
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for text a server supplies that reaches the model or the approver, namely tool descriptions, declared inputs, and results, given that a server could use it to steer either one? [Gap]
- [x] CHK007 - Does the spec say which configuration details the catalog must leave out, such as a launch command's arguments, an address, and the variable names in `pass_env`? [Gap, Spec §FR-014, §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 - Is "a recorded approve or edit decision for that specific proposal" defined: what identifies a proposal, and where the decision is recorded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 - Is "no declared input" defined in the spec, and does the definition agree with the plan's rule (no properties, or an empty set) for a tool whose input is declared without named properties? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009, Research §R9]
- [x] CHK010 - Does "arguments the tool's declared input does not accept" say whether an argument the declared input does not name is refused or allowed? [Clarity, Spec §US2 scenario 3]
- [x] CHK011 - Is "an address that does not refer to the local machine" defined in the spec with criteria a reviewer can apply, or only in the contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Contract §Rules]
- [x] CHK012 - Is "a credential the server was given" specific about which forms are in scope for "MUST NOT appear": the exact value only, or also encoded and partial forms? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, §US4 scenario 5, Research §R12]
- [x] CHK013 - Does "logs" in FR-002 say whether it includes what a launched server writes to its own error output, which the plan passes through unchanged? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, Research §R12]
- [x] CHK014 - Is "presented as the server's own claim" specific enough that a reader cannot mistake a hint for the classification, and does it say whether hints may appear in the pause event? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK015 - Is "workspace-confined" in FR-011 defined, and does the requirement clearly cover the delegation tool, which is not a file tool? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Research §R8]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 - Do the spec's two classifications, read-only and effectful, agree with the three values the plan and the API contract report, and is the third value traceable from the spec itself? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006, §Key Entities, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the plan's choice to stop startup for one of Freyja's own tools that has no classification consistent with the feature description, which says unclassified tools are gated? [Conflict, Spec §Input, §FR-006, Research §R8]
- [x] CHK018 - Are the places where a credential must not appear listed the same way in FR-002, User Story 4 scenario 5, FR-017, the plan, and the configuration contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §US4 scenario 5, §FR-017, Research §R12, Contract §Credentials]
- [x] CHK019 - Do the plan and the contract agree on which parts of the catalog are redacted: only a server's error text, or also descriptions, declared inputs, and hints? [Conflict, Research §R12, Contract §Credentials]
- [x] CHK020 - Is "exactly one call" on approval consistent with "MUST try to connect again", and is it stated that reconnecting never sends an approved call a second time? [Consistency, Spec §US2 scenario 2, §FR-012, Research §R7]
- [x] CHK021 - The assumptions say unauthenticated access to the catalog and to approval "is documented"; does FR-016 require the README to say so? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK022 - Does "every subagent" in FR-007 agree with the plan, which wires the gate to the one general-purpose subagent, for a subagent added later? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §Assumptions, Research §R8]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK023 - Is there a success criterion for the absence of credentials in output, as SC-001 exists for the gate? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK024 - Can SC-001's "100% of effectful and unclassified delegate tool calls" be counted objectively: are the call routes that must be exercised listed? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK025 - Does FR-017's "absence of credentials in output" name the outputs to inspect: the stream, thread state, logs, the catalog, and startup errors? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK026 - Can "the model's own judgment MUST NOT influence the classification" be verified, and is an acceptance scenario defined for it as one is for server labels? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, §US2 scenario 6]
- [x] CHK027 - Is the refusal of a non-local address tied to an acceptance scenario, or only to an edge case and FR-004? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US4, §Edge Cases]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for a step that proposes several gated tools, or gated and read-only tools together: which calls run, and when? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §US2]
- [x] CHK029 - Are requirements defined for an approved call that times out or fails after it reached the server: that the user is told the effect may have happened, and that the call is not retried? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-012, Research §R7]
- [x] CHK030 - Are requirements defined for a pending proposal decided after a restart with a changed configuration: the tool removed, moved to the read-only list, or now provided under the same name by a different server? [Coverage, Recovery Flow, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §R9]
- [x] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for a server whose tool list, descriptions, or declared inputs change after startup: which definition governs a later approval and the validation of an edit? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-003]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK032 - Are address forms near the boundary of the local rule addressed: a `localhost` name that resolves elsewhere, a redirect from a local address to another host, an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address, `0.0.0.0`, and an address that carries user information? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-001, Contract §Rules]
- [x] CHK033 - Are requirements defined for a credential value that is empty, very short, or equal to a common word, where replacing every occurrence would garble unrelated output? [Edge Case, Gap, Research §R12]
- [x] CHK034 - Is the scope of redaction specified when one server's text contains a credential that was passed to a different server? [Edge Case, Gap, Research §R12]
- [x] CHK035 - Does the spec say what happens when an operator puts a credential in a launch command's arguments or in an address: refused, warned about, or accepted as unprotected? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002, Contract §Credentials]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK036 - Is the assumption that the existing gate and resume validation are "reused unchanged" still accurate, given that the proposal gains a server name and edits are validated against a server's declared input? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Research §R9]
- [x] CHK037 - Is the dependence of the classification of Freyja's own tools on a pinned Deep Agents version recorded as an assumption, with what must happen on an upgrade? [Dependency, Research §R8]
- [x] CHK038 - Is the accepted risk that anyone who can reach the port can approve a proposal bounded by a stated requirement that the service keeps its local binding by default? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK039 - Is it documented as an accepted risk that the arguments of a tool on the read-only list reach its server with no review, so such a tool can carry data out? [Assumption, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK040 - Is the reliance on the MCP client library for the environment a launched process inherits recorded as a dependency to re-check when the library is upgraded? [Dependency, Research §R2, Contract §Shape]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- References: `Spec §FR-007` is a functional requirement and `Spec §US2 scenario 3` an acceptance scenario in `spec.md`; `Research §R8` is a decision in `research.md`; `Contract §Rules` is a section of `contracts/server-config.md`; `Plan §...` is a section of `plan.md`
- `[Gap]` marks a requirement that appears to be missing; `[Ambiguity]` and `[Conflict]` mark wording to resolve; `[Assumption]` and `[Dependency]` mark something relied on but not required
- Add findings inline under the item they belong to
